result.reason: The clause satisfies the fallback: the cap is mutual and at least equal to 12 months’ fees, and Section 8 (apparently indemnification), confidentiality, gross negligence, and willful misconduct are uncapped. It also adopts the preferred $1 million floor and adds fraud. It does not fully reach the preferred position because it omits express carve-outs for data protection/security obligations and infringement of the other party’s IP, and does not clarify that Customer payment obligations are not damages. The change from measuring fees before filing of the claim to measuring them before the underlying event is unnecessary and may materially alter the fee period, so the redline is not fully minimal. Otherwise, it preserves the damages exclusion and unrelated commercial allocation and is professionally drafted.
